name: coverage-opinion
description: Drafts insurance coverage opinion letters and memos on the duty to defend and the duty to indemnify under liability policies, primarily commercial general liability (CGL), for an insurer or a policyholder. Reconciles the declarations, forms schedule, edition dates and endorsements actually issued; settles choice of law; applies the governing four-corners, eight-corners or extrinsic-evidence rule; works the insuring agreement before exclusions with the burden at each step; tests occurrence and claims-made triggers, retroactive dates, known-loss and continuous injury; analyzes late notice and prejudice, reservation of rights and disclaimer timing, waiver and estoppel, Cumis and independent counsel conflicts, other insurance and allocation across policies. Use for a coverage opinion, coverage position, duty to defend analysis, reservation of rights review, disclaimer, tender response or additional insured question. Routes policy-limits demands to bad-faith-demand and general demands to demand-letter.
